Walmart Is Paying $50,000,000 To Settle DOJ Claims Over Opioid Prescriptions Lawsuit
summary:
Walmart agreed to pay $50 million to resolve DOJ and DEA allegations that its pharmacies illegally filled thousands of invalid opioid and controlled substance prescriptions since 2013. The settlement includes a new DEA compliance agreement with reporting and monitoring requirements.
The post Walmart Is Paying $50,000,000 To Settle DOJ Claims Over Opioid Prescriptions Lawsuit appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: Walmart has agreed to pay fifty million dollars to settle allegations from the Department of Justice and the Drug Enforcement Administration regarding the unlawful filling of invalid opioid and controlled substance prescriptions dating back to 2013. In addition to the financial settlement, the agreement includes a new compliance framework featuring enhanced monitoring and reporting requirements for the company's pharmacies.
